messages:
Samir: Pager hit for high queue depth on rdp-dedicated-3; primary didn't acknowledge handoff. latency up on /generate, some 504s. dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/obs/shard/rdp-dedicated-3 :eyes:
incident-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-20279 — High queue depth on rdp-dedicated-3. Severity: P1. Pager sent to oncall rotation.
Priya: I'm primary for this shift, phone was DND. just saw the page, coming online.
Alex: FYI I tried to handoff ~20m ago, secondary didn't accept. looks like the scheduler misrouted some pods and the pool got starved.
Samir: Impact: increased tail latency (~2-3x), errors for some EU customers. CS notified for affected tenants.
Priya: grabbing runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-shard-fallback — steps 1-5.
Priya: quick triage commands I'm running now:
```
# check pod status & logs
kubectl -n inference get pods -l shard=rdp-dedicated-3
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/rdp-dedicated-3 --tail=200
# check scheduler bindings
redwoodctl infra leases list --shard rdp-dedicated-3
```
Samir: If primary is unreachable for >10m escalate to SRE lead @marie and infra oncall @infra-oncall. Also enable cross-region fallback if needed.
Alex: I can reattach the spare pool and bump capacity +1 to drain queue. Running: `redwoodctl pool reattach rdp-dedicated-3 --from spare-1`
deploy-bot: Deployment started: operation 0a3f -> reattach pool (operator: Alex). ETA ~2m.
Priya: I'm enabling the fallback routing for 20% traffic to rdp-dedicated-fallback policy: `redwoodctl routing split --shard rdp-dedicated-3 --fallback rdp-dedicated-fallback --pct 20`
Samir: CS update: accounts-team notified, two enterprise tenants seeing 504s, they've escalated to account owner.
Alex: reattach finished, pods healthy. logs show a spike in KV cache misses during transition, error rate dropping.
Priya: monitoring: 504s down 70% in EU; latency trending back to normal. continuing to watch for 10m.
Samir: If we don't see steady improvement within 15m we open a bridge and page infra-oncall + SRE lead.
Priya: Note for handoff: primary must confirm receipt of pager and run the runbook smoke check (below) before leaving shift. add to checklist: `pager test -> run runbook smoke -> confirm via this channel`
Alex: Temporary mitigation applied: reattach + scale + partial routing. I'll leave the scaling + routing in place until stable; will rollback routing after 30m of stable metrics.
incident-bot: Update: INC-20279 status -> mitigating. responders: Priya, Alex, Samir.
marie: thanks all — if anything needs exec power call me. I'll stand by for bridge if error rate rebounds.
Priya: Creating incident timeline in the incident ticket and will add exact commands + timestamps. Also filing a follow-up runbook tweak: ensure scheduler fallback doesn't allow pool starvation.
Samir: Handoff note for next shift (copy into shift doc): primary=Priya (confirmed), secondary=Alex (covering), escalation path: primary -> secondary -> SRE lead @marie -> infra oncall @infra-oncall -> eng-lead paging. Confirm pager preferences before handoff.
Priya: Ok wrapping up here, metrics stable for 22m, 504s at normal levels. I'll mark this as mitigated in the ticket and assign postmortem to runtime team.
Samir: Adding action items: 1) scheduler failover test 2) runbook update (link) 3) add explicit pager acceptance step to handoff checklist.
incident-bot: INC-20279 state updated -> mitigated. Postmortem ticket: PMT-4782 created.
Priya: Leaving this thread for the next oncall — please review PMT-4782 and confirm if you'd like the short RCA draft in the morning. :white_check_mark:
